our_story.heading: Beauty that believes in better.
our_story.text: Glownest was born from a simple belief: skincare should be clean, effective, and kind to the planet. We combine the best of science and nature to create products that deliver real results without compromise.

timeline.title: The Beginning
timeline.text: Founded in Paris with a mission to create skincare that's both effective and sustainable.

timeline.title: First Collection
timeline.text: Launched our signature Glow Serum and Hydra Moisturizer to overwhelming positive response.

timeline.title: Global Reach
timeline.text: Expanded to 30+ countries, earning trust from over 100,000 customers worldwide.

timeline.title: Today
timeline.text: Continuing to innovate with clean formulas backed by science and loved by all skin types.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.summary: Everything about how we get your order to you.

sections.heading: Shipping methods
sections.body: Standard (tracked) and Express (priority tracked) delivery are available at checkout.

sections.heading: Delivery estimates
sections.body: Standard: 5–8 business days. Express: 2–3 business days. Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days.

sections.heading: Shipping charges
sections.body: Standard shipping is free on orders above the free-shipping threshold shown in your cart. Express is always charged at the rate shown at checkout.

sections.heading: Tracking
sections.body: You receive an email and a dashboard notification with your tracking number as soon as your order ships.

sections.heading: Delivery conditions
sections.body: Please make sure your address is complete and that someone can receive the parcel. Contact us promptly if your parcel is delayed.

sections.heading: Return policy
sections.body: If you are not happy, you may request a return within 30 days of delivery.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: Items must be unused or less than 20% used, in original packaging. Opened products that caused a reaction are always eligible.

sections.heading: How to return
sections.body: Open the order in your dashboard and choose Request return. We reply within one business day with instructions.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days of us receiving the parcel.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: Account details, order and delivery information, and the preferences you give us (such as your skincare quiz answers).

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: To fulfil orders, provide support, personalise recommendations, and — only with your consent — send marketing emails.

sections.heading: Data protection
sections.body: Data is stored with Supabase using encryption in transit and at rest. Payments are processed by our payment partners; we never store card numbers.

sections.heading: Cookies and tracking
sections.body: We use essential cookies for sign-in and your cart, and optional analytics if enabled.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct, export or delete your data, and unsubscribe from marketing at any time.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Email hello@glownest.com with any privacy question.
